_about: Furan (1) + Toluene (2): total pressures against temperature, 313.02-352.99 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of furan, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: P. Theveneau, A. Valtz, C. Coquelet, Vapor Liquid Equilibrium Data for the Furan-Toluene Binary System between 313.02 and 352.99 K, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 1168-1172
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
